output_list.criticism: The 'distr' function has an integer overflow that allows the owner to set the balances of an arbitrary user to a ridiculously high value. This vulnerability can lead to a loss of funds for the affected user and potentially the contract owner.

The 'getTokens' function has an integer overflow that allows the owner to set the value of 'toGive' to a very large number, causing a overflow in the distribution. This vulnerability can lead to a loss of funds for the affected user and potentially the contract owner.
